conventions.name: db-schema-barrel-purity
conventions.description: apps/*/db/schema/index.ts re-exports its sibling schema files and nothing else — no local declarations, no non-schema imports. Evidence: sibling schema files re-exported via `export * from` across apps (tiffin-grab, puchkaman, xplorers).

conventions.name: component-file-exports-matching-pascal-case
conventions.description: A component file components/**/{fileName}.tsx exports a symbol named PascalCase(fileName) — kebab-case filename, PascalCase component export. Evidence: manually verified across sampled files in tiffin-grab (identity-gate.tsx -> IdentityGate, status-banner.tsx -> StatusBanner, org-switcher.tsx -> OrgSwitcher, plan-hero.tsx -> PlanHero); consistent with the 228/228 kebab-case-filename finding from the broader evidence sweep. Files under __tests__ excluded (test files, not components). apps/puchkaman is excluded whole (sunsetted 2026-10-13, no active development). The other 10 excludeFiles are multi-export 'collection' files (3-13 exports each: icon sets, chart groups, auth kits, legal and marketing primitives, shared class-name constants, the admin date/time/month inputs) — a genuinely different semantic cohort from 'one file = one component', confirmed by inspecting each file's actual export list before excluding.

conventions.name: root-has-no-stray-files
conventions.description: A top-level entry is a directory unless it is one of the known repo files (workspace/tooling config and the root docs). One-off scripts, command output and scratch files do not belong at the root. Evidence: 18 of 32 tracked root files are config/docs; the other 14 were throwaway fix-*.js / run_drizzle.exp scripts left by a single lint-fix session.

conventions.name: app-root-has-no-stray-files
conventions.description: A top-level entry of apps/<client> is a directory unless it is tool config (*.config.ts|mjs, vitest.*.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json, components.json), a Next.js root file (proxy, instrumentation) or an agent/product doc. Lint dumps, logs and scratch output do not belong there. Evidence: 12 file names are shared by 3 of 3 apps and 3 more by 2 of 3, all config or docs; the outliers were lint.json, *-lint.txt, eslint-log.txt, xplorers-lint.json and the shell-redirect accidents `10` and `20`.
